entities.name: Oketra
entities.description: Cat-headed goddess of solidarity on Amonkhet, an archer who protected Naktamun; killed by the Scorpion God and later zombified as a God-Eternal.

entities.name: Naktamun
entities.description: City on Amonkhet watched over by Oketra.

entities.name: Hekma
entities.description: Desert beyond the city where monsters lurk.

entities.name: Trial of Solidarity
entities.description: The first trial undergone by initiates, in which crops stand or fall together.

entities.name: Scorpion God
entities.description: God who killed Oketra in the Hour of Promise.

entities.name: Hour of Devastation
entities.description: Catastrophe unleashed on Naktamun by Nicol Bolas.

entities.name: Nicol Bolas
entities.description: Elder dragon planeswalker who unleashed the Hour of Devastation and led the God-Eternals in the War of the Spark.

entities.name: War of the Spark
entities.description: Battle on Ravnica in which Oketra fought as a God-Eternal.

entities.name: Ravnica
entities.description: Plane where the War of the Spark took place.

entities.name: Liliana Vess
entities.description: Planeswalker who commanded Oketra, interfered with her shot at Gideon, and then ordered her to attack Bolas.

entities.name: Gideon Jura
entities.description: Planeswalker who charged at Bolas; Oketra shot at him.

entities.name: Bontu
entities.description: God-Eternal who bit Bolas and despark him.

entities.name: Niv-Mizzet
entities.description: Dragon who impaled Bolas with Hazoret's spear.

entities.name: Hazoret
entities.description: God whose spear Niv-Mizzet used against Bolas.

entities.name: Ketramose
entities.description: New leonine god born after the restoration of Naktamun who considers Oketra his mother and carries her bow.

entities.name: New Phyrexian Invasion
entities.description: Invasion after which Naktamun was restored.

events.summary: Oketra patrols Naktamun, shooting dangers seen through the Hekma and leading initiates through the first Trial.
events.quote: She patrolled the city's streets, firing golden arrows at any dangers she saw

events.summary: Oketra is killed by the Scorpion God in the Hour of Promise after healing people of Naktamun.
events.quote: Oketra was killed by the Scorpion God

events.summary: Oketra is zombified and reappears as a God-Eternal in Bolas's army on Ravnica.
events.quote: she reappeared as a God-Eternal in Bolas's army

events.summary: Under Liliana's command Oketra shoots at Gideon, but Liliana makes the arrow hit his Pegasus instead.
events.quote: Liliana interfered, causing the Divine Arrow to miss and impale Gideon's Pegasus instead

events.summary: Liliana commands Oketra and Bontu to attack Bolas; Niv-Mizzet impales Bolas, Bolas obliterates Oketra, and Bontu despark him.
Ketramose is born as Oketra's spiritual successor after Naktamun is restored.
events.quote: a new leonine god named Ketramose was born to embody hope for the future

relations.quote: Oketra was killed by the Scorpion God

relations.note: considers Oketra his mother and spiritual predecessor
relations.quote: Ketramose considers Oketra his mother and spiritual predecessor
Oketra's presence in Naktamun was a symbol of hope and unity
